Write commit messages that are Keep a Changelog–ready (https://keepachangelog.com/).

Rules:
* Start the subject with one category: Added | Changed | Deprecated | Removed | Fixed | Security
* Subject: imperative mood, ≤72 chars, optional [scope]; no emojis.
* Optional body: short bullets, same category context

Examples:
Added: CSV export in [reports]
Fixed: null crash in auth flow
Removed: legacy v1 endpoints [api]
